display_long_description:
Get ready to feel the speed! 🏁

Formula Car Racing Game puts you directly behind the wheel of a powerful Formula-style race car in an immersive VR racing experience for Meta Quest. Feel the intensity of high-speed racing as you accelerate down the track, attack corners, and compete for the fastest lap.

Designed to deliver an exciting and accessible racing experience, the game lets you experience the thrill of Formula racing from the driver's seat. Every turn, straightaway, and braking zone becomes a test of your control, timing, and racing skills.

🔥 Race at Full Speed
Push your Formula car to its limits and experience the excitement of high-speed competition.

🏎️ Immersive VR Driving
Step into the cockpit and experience racing from a first-person perspective designed for Meta Quest.

🏁 Master the Track
Learn every corner, improve your racing line, and chase faster lap times.

⚡ Competitive Racing
Challenge yourself to become faster and aim for the top of the leaderboard.

🎮 Built for Meta Quest
Enjoy an immersive racing experience designed specifically for VR.

Pre-order now and get ready to start your engines!

Put on your headset, take control of your Formula car, and discover what it takes to become a racing champion. The track is waiting. 🏆
